'''Jerren''' was a [[Gender/Legends|Female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Vaiken Spacedock]], Jerren also provided the knowledge of synthweaving to others.
